title: News | Kaderblick Docs

hero.heading: News
hero.lead: News distributes formatted posts to the whole platform, a club or a team. Visible posts and management actions depend on visibility, relationships and authorship.

body:
Read news

Select a card to open the complete formatted post. The label below the text shows Platform, Club or Team and names the specific club or team where relevant.

The open post combines title, content, author, publication date and visibility. Images and links in formatted content are displayed at full width.

Create a news post

New post appears if your account has permission.

  1. Enter a required title of at most 200 characters.
  2. Write in the rich-text editor. Its toolbar provides formatting, lists, links, images and further editor actions.
  3. Check with Preview; Continue editing returns to the editor.
  4. Set Visibility to platform, club or team. Club and team require the specific assignment.
  5. Select Publish. The action is disabled during transfer and shows its status.

Automatically saved draft

Kaderblick stores title, content and visibility locally for your account while you edit. Reopening offers a draft with its save date. Discard removes it. Successful publication deletes it; a failed automatic save displays a warning.

Use templates

Template opens prepared structures for platform update, new feature, match preview, match report, announcement, tournament, feature introduction and an image post. A preview appears before applying. If text already exists, Kaderblick asks before replacing it.

Edit and delete

The author and a Superadmin see edit and delete. Editing retains title and rich-text content and also provides preview and templates. Deletion requires confirmation containing the post title.

Empty view

Without visible posts, Kaderblick shows an empty state. Users with permission can create the first post there; other accounts only see that none are available.

Connections to other areas

  • Dashboard: its news widget shows current posts.
  • Notifications: the Club news category controls notices for new posts.
  • Clubs and teams: these assignments determine visible restricted posts.

Visibility by role and relationship

  • Readers: see platform posts and posts for assigned clubs and teams.
  • Authors with permission: also see New post and their available club and team targets.
  • Author and Superadmin: can edit or delete an existing post.
